This small plot here near my home is good land, and since I have some schooling I know that maize does best with a little fertilizer — here in Iringa we get good rains and the soil rewards you if you put something back. I will buy one small bag of CAN to top-dress, and I will also carry some manure from the boma since it is only a short walk to this plot. I will use improved seed because my neighbors and the extension officer say the new varieties give more cobs, and since the plot is small the seed cost is manageable. I will work it mostly with my family — pesticides and irrigation are not for this plot, water comes from the rains and weeding by hand is enough.
